ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is quadrilateral WXYZ. The left WX and the right ZY are both vertical sides, and each has a pink arrow mark in the same direction, indicating WX ∥ ZY. The upper side WZ and the lower side XY are labeled with length 23. The interior angle at vertex W is labeled 112°, and the problem asks for m∠Z. Reasoning: Because WX ∥ ZY, segment WZ is a transversal cutting these two parallel lines. ∠W and ∠Z are on the same side of transversal WZ and between the two parallel lines, so they are same-side interior angles, and their sum is 180°. method.method_draft: Read the diagram as trapezoid WXYZ with the left side WX and right side ZY marked parallel by matching arrow symbols. The given interior angle at W is 112°, and the question asks for m∠Z. Treat WZ as a transversal crossing the parallel sides WX and ZY. Consecutive interior angles on the same side of a transversal are supplementary, so m∠W + m∠Z = 180°. Compute m∠Z = 180° - 112° = 68°.
